messages.en:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook {ff 00 00 00}has the best
selection of furniture
in town,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
I mean, true, he's got the
only selection in town, but
still.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 19 00}Every time I come in here,
I always find something new
and exciting, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nookil {ff 00 00 00}on linna
parim mööbli-
valik,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
Ma mõtlen, tõsi küll, tal on
ainus valik linnas, aga
siiski.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 19 00}Iga kord, kui ma siia tulen,
leian ma midagi uut ja
põnevat, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, fancy meeting
you here, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0b 00}So how's the shopping
going? Find anything you
just can't live without?{07 00 00}
{07 0d 00}I really want one of those!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Oh, and that looks good,
too.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, milline kohtumine
siin, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0b 00}Nii, kuidas ostlemine
läheb? Leidsid midagi, ilma
milleta sa elada ei saa?{07 00 00}
{07 0d 00}Ma tahan väga üht neist!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Oh, ja see näeb ka hea
välja.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, I can tell that
you've got a good eye for
furniture, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Have fun shopping, {01 00 00 05 00}but stay
out of my way, just in
case, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ma näen, et sul
on mööbli suhtes hea
silm, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Head ostlemist, {01 00 00 05 00}aga hoia
mu teelt eemale, igaks
juhuks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you're here?{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 00 00}I'm just looking around,
really{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
At least, that's what I'd
planned on doing, {01 00 00 0a 00}but{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 17 00}I'm not sure I can resist!
{07 0e 00}There's only one way to
solve this.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}

Eenie meenie minie more,
which will look best
on my floor, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa oled siin?{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 00 00}Ma lihtsalt vaatan ringi,
tõesti{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Vähemalt seda ma
plaanisin teha, {01 00 00 0a 00}aga{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 17 00}ma pole kindel, kas suudan!
{07 0e 00}On ainult üks viis seda
lahendada.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}

Enne, kenne, kiki, pau,
mis näeb mu põrandal
kõige parem, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
A while ago,{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00} told
me he wants to{01 01 00} put out a
CD, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}He said he wants a top 40
single, something we'll hear
all day, every day.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}I really hope he doesn't
put out a CD.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Mõni aeg tagasi{01 00 00 0a 00} ütles {ff 00 00 06}Nook{ff 00 00 00}
mulle, et ta tahab{01 01 00} CD
välja anda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}Ta ütles, et tahab hitti,
midagi, mida me kuuleme
terve päeva, iga päev.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}Ma tõesti loodan, et ta ei

messages.en:
I'm not all that interested
in collecting furniture.

{07 0d 00}And yet,{01 00 00 05 00} the moment I walk
in here, I suddenly get the
urge to start buying stuff.
{07 16 00}I think {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook {ff 00 00 00}is pumping
something into the air!
messages.et:
Mind ei huvita eriti
mööbli kogumine.

{07 0d 00}Ja ometi,{01 00 00 05 00} niipea kui ma siia
sisse astun, tekib mul äkki
tung asju ostma.
{07 16 00}Ma arvan, et {ff 00 00 06}Nook {ff 00 00 00}pumpab
midagi õhku!
